source_row.rationale: ACOG's fetal heart tracing definitions identify a normal baseline fetal heart rate as 110–160 beats/min and use the three-tier Category I/II/III framework. Option D is therefore correct. Option A includes values below the bradycardia threshold. Option B widens both the lower and upper limits beyond the standard range. Option C excludes normal values from 110–119 and includes values above the tachycardia threshold. Currentness was rechecked against ACOG Clinical Practice Guideline No. 10 from October 2025, which continues to use the three-tier intrapartum classification framework.
